svg.title: Luciazero: make coding agents prove their work. Lucia, the mascot, stands beside a terminal where an agent claims all tests pass, ./test.sh exits 1, the fix lands with a regression test, ./test.sh exits 0, and /done runs full verify, then a revert probe that shows the new test fails without the fix.
